frontier.hypothesis: An OUTSIDE pressure source -- an insn that is ready at sched2's T-30 but whose own emission slot is not target's slot-23 load-delay slot -- would let the +4 address load reach slot 12 in $a1 while all three 0x10 loads survive. This is the ONLY surviving pure-C door after s10.
frontier.mechanism: The +4 load is pinned adjacent to its single consumer only because it is the sole ready insn at that cycle; a second ready insn breaks the starvation. Dependence-free sources (idx read, outer+0x18, outer+0x20) are also the cheapest filler for the load-delay slot at forward slot 23 and steal it (f3, g1 both 8/66); dependent sources either break the copy triple (c4) or cost instructions (d1, c5).
